properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared npm dependency (yarn.lock): hash.js 1.1.3, the SHA-1/SHA-2 hashing layer used by My-Wallet-V3's helpers (Blockchain.Helpers). No direct hash call site in the frontend source (assets/ contains no sha/hash literals); this records the shipped dependency surface. SHA-2 is not urgent under Grover; CNSA 2.0 nonetheless prefers 384-bit digests.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared npm dependency (yarn.lock): elliptic 6.4.0 supplies secp256k1 ECDSA — the signature primitive behind this wallet's Bitcoin/Ethereum transaction signing. The frontend itself signs through My-Wallet-V3's payment.sign() wrapper (no direct elliptic import in assets/), so this entry records what the shipped dependency tree provides. Shor-vulnerable; replacement is protocol-constrained because secp256k1 is consensus-mandated by Bitcoin/Ethereum.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared npm dependency (yarn.lock): tweetnacl 0.14.5 exposes X25519 scalar multiplication (crypto_scalarmult). No direct call site in the frontend source; the algorithm ships in the dependency tree. Quantum-unsafe key agreement (Shor) — migration target ML-KEM-768.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared npm dependency (yarn.lock): tweetnacl 0.14.5's authenticated encryption (XSalsa20-Poly1305). Symmetric AE — quantum-safe within Grover margins; no direct call site in the frontend source, so this records the shipped dependency surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Declared npm dependency (yarn.lock): selfsigned 1.9.1 generates self-signed X.509 certificates (built on node-forge, also in the lockfile). No live use site in this repo (server.js serves plain HTTP); recorded as available in the shipped dependency tree, presumably dev/test tooling. Self-signed certs assert no third-party identity; the cert keys/signatures underneath are classical (Shor-vulnerable in kind, low stakes in practice).
